rules.company_naming: Use verified current commercial/legal company name from official company site or authoritative registry. Never infer a brand name from an email domain. Preserve accents, capitalization and legal suffix when verified.
rules.language: Write the first-touch email in the recipient market's business language below. For multilingual markets, resolve language from official company website/contact page before drafting. If unresolved, use the listed fallback only.
rules.contact: Use public role/business addresses. Do not use private/personal addresses unless independently established as an intended business contact and permitted for the campaign.
rules.draft_gate: No draft becomes send-ready until company_name_verified=true, business_contact_verified=true, language_verified=true and do_not_contact=false.
rules.personalization: Reference only procurement categories, geography, public awards or capabilities actually evidenced for that company. Never fabricate a tender, project, buyer relationship or pain point.
rules.dedupe: One active first-touch per legal entity per campaign. Subsidiaries may be separate only when independently verified as separate operating entities.
rules.opt_out: Respect explicit opt-outs, no-advertising flags and prior negative replies across future campaigns.
